about: ci-oops fault isolation (cmuxterm-hq ci-self-heal, part 0d). The units a pull request's CI build may drop when they, and only they, fail to compile: the rest builds and runs, and the job prints one CI_OOPS line per dropped unit (outcome soft_failed) for the follow-up. Everything not listed is core and stays strict. A build that is not a pull_request event, or whose workflow or base is a ship path (nightly, release, promote, stable, publish), never drops anything (scripts/ci/oops/isolate.py allowed()). A new unit says why the product builds and runs without it; tests/test_ci_oops_isolate.py checks each entry.

units.name: glass-parity
units.why: The web half of the Liquid Glass Parity playground (debug.glass_parity, DEV and NIGHTLY only); no other page or shipped view imports it.

units.name: debug-settings
units.why: The debug tunables page; a debugging aid that no other page imports.

units.name: chief-usage
units.why: The Chief Usage analytics page; a leaf page that no other page imports, opened only from its own action.

units.name: chief-views
units.why: The Chief view gallery page beside the Chief in Home; a leaf page that no other page imports.

units.name: chief-inspector
units.why: The remote Chief memory inspector page (the inspector compiled into optchat-chief is Native/OptChat/optchat-chief/inspector, built apart); no other page imports it.

units.name: stats
units.why: The usage Stats page; a leaf page that no other page imports, opened only from its own action.

units.name: task-manager
units.why: The Task Manager page (CPU and memory per cmux process); a diagnostic leaf page that no other page imports.

units.name: stash
units.why: The Stashed Tabs page; a leaf page that no other page imports. Stashed groups live in the daemon, not the page, so a build without it loses no data.

units.name: gallery
units.why: The component gallery and its entries (*.gallery.ts(x)): a review and screenshot tool that no app bundle ships, so an entry's type error never reaches a user.

units.name: cmux-palette-eval
units.why: The palette ranker's quality eval, speed bench and cases: a test-only workspace member that no other member depends on and no app, daemon or CLI build links (kept outside cmux-palette-ranker so it never touches the app FFI pin).

not_units.changelog page: Core, not optional: the Updated card and What's New after an update render from it (dozens of updated-card and whats-new tests import it).
not_units.theme packs: Resources/ghostty/themes and Resources/cmux-themes are data with no compile step: a bad theme file fails a test, not a compile, so there is nothing to drop.
not_units.first-party apps: first-party-apps/* commit their built dist/main.js and `bun first-party-apps/build.ts --check` gates them together; dropping one app needs build.ts to take a skip list (proposed, not built).
not_units.cargo features: PR clippy lints default features only, so no optional cargo feature compiles on a pull request today; the sim and iroh-transport feature runs are their own named steps.
